evidence_set: Actuarial cumulative probability of transition from first use to DSM-IV dependence: lifetime 8.9% for cannabis, 67.5% nicotine, 22.7% alcohol, 20.9% cocaine; one decade after first use 5.9% for cannabis; within the first year almost 2% (given jointly for nicotine, alcohol and cannabis); half of the cases of cannabis dependence were observed about 5 years after first use (a median among the people who became dependent, not among everyone who used). No confidence intervals are given for any cumulative probability.
